## A table that leans every way | left | centre | right | none | |:-----|:------:|------:|------| | a | b | c | d | | aa | bb | cc | dd | > a quotation, which the renderer sets in from the edge > and which runs to a second line The end.

A script with a bit of everything in it:

```bash
if [[ -d "$DIR" ]]; then
    echo "there"
elif [[ -f "$DIR" ]]; then
    echo "a file"
else
    echo "nowhere"
fi

while read -r NAME; do
    echo "$NAME" > out.txt 2>&1
done < list.txt

until [[ -z "$REST" ]]; do
    REST=""
done

case "$MODE" in
    read)  echo reading ;;
    write) echo writing ;;
    *)     echo other ;;
esac

select CHOICE in one two; do break; done

ls -la | grep -v '^d' | wc -l
```

And a pattern with a unicode class in it:

```regexp
^\p{Lu}\w{2,8}(?:-\d+)?$
```
